privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body1: Clink collects no personal information. There are no accounts, no ads and no third-party trackers.
privacy.body2: To learn which parts of the game work well, Clink sends anonymous events (like which level you opened) tagged with a random ID created on your device. The ID is not linked to you.
privacy.body3: Your progress is stored on this device only. Use the code in Settings to move it to another browser.
songbook.empty: Solve a level to add its song here.
install.title: Add Clink to your home screen
install.why: Play full screen, even offline, and keep your progress safe.

a11y.board: Puzzle board. Press 1 to 5 to tap a glass, F for the faucet, S for the sink, Space to hear the melody, Z to undo.
guide.listen: Tap a glass to hear its note.
guide.pour: Now tap another glass to pour water into it.
guide.tuned: Every note in the bar is ringing. You tuned it!
guide.melody: Tap the melody bar to hear the song.
guide.goal: Pour until every note in the bar lights up.
guide.found: A note lights up while a glass rings it.
guide.giveUp: Sometimes you must give up a note to finish.
guide.faucet: The faucet fills a glass to the brim. Select a glass, then tap the faucet.
guide.sink: The sink empties a glass. Select a glass, then tap the sink.
guide.ice: Ice melts into water after the number of moves shown.
